unit.why: A first-person narrative of the death, mourning, eulogy and burial of the tzaddik's wife, the rebbetzin, in the Kozhenitz court.
unit.boundary_note: opens with 'ונחזור להנ"ל', resuming an earlier account (the omen seen on 1 Nisan) from a preceding division

stories.start_quote: ונחזור להנ"ל כי הנה מאז ביום א׳ ניסן
stories.end_quote: לנגד עיניו אותיות שם הוי״ה ברור וצלול
stories.summary_en: The tzaddik receives several signs of his wife's coming death. She dies on the last Sabbath of Pesach and he stays outwardly composed until the holy day ends, then weeps aloud and eulogizes her as righteous. At her burial he tells her that their souls and yihudim will remain together.
